summary: HomeTrust Bancshares filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026 announcing completion of its prior 5% buyback and board authorization of a new repurchase program for up to 790,000 shares, roughly 5% of current shares outstanding. The completed program, begun August 2026, repurchased 832,000 shares at an average price of $47.70. Purchases may occur in open market or privately negotiated transactions depending on market conditions. No advisor, premium, or expiration date is stated. Watch execution pace, tangible book value accretion, and any signaling on valuation or capital deployment.
